verses.1: And those who are weak in faith, please accept them as such, without any kind of discrimination or judgment.
verses.2: One believes in eating everything; the other, on the other hand, only eats weak plants.
verses.3: He who eats what he shouldn’t eat, should not be punished; but he who doesn’t eat what he should, should also not be punished. For God has chosen him for this purpose.
verses.4: Who are you, then, who judges another’s household? Either you stand by your own master, or you will be punished. After all, it’s the master who has the power to decide that.
verses.5: Some judge every day, while others judge every single day. Each of them will inform me in detail about each individual case.
verses.6: He who thinks about the day, does so with great care. And he who eats, does so for the sake of God; for he gives thanks to God. And he who does not eat, does so without any intention of giving thanks to God.
verses.7: For none of us lives alone, and none dies alone either.
verses.8: For whether we live or die, it is the Lord who determines that. Whether we live or die, it also depends on the Lord. So, whether we live or die, it still belongs to the Lord.
verses.9: For in this very purpose died Christ, so that he might save both the dead and those who are living.
verses.10: But what do you think of your brother? Or what do you control over him? For we will all submit to the steps of God.
verses.11: It is written, “I will live,” says the Lord. All languages will be recognized by God.
verses.12: Therefore, each of us should give an opinion about himself.
verses.13: So, we shouldn’t judge each other like this. Instead, it’s better to avoid making any excuses or excuses for our brothers.
verses.14: I also know from Jesus that nothing is common to everyone. If something isn’t common to the one who judges, then it’s not common to anyone else either.
verses.15: For if your brother is grieved because of some impurity, then you no longer act out of love. Do not let that impurity get in the way of your love for Christ. He died for that impurity.
verses.16: So, I will not speak ill of you.
verses.17: For the kingdom of God is not about finding or possessing something, but rather about justice, peace, and joy in a holy spirit.
verses.18: For he serves Christ here with joyfulness to God, and is a model for people.
verses.19: Therefore, let us also seek peace between ourselves, as well as harmony in our relationships with one another.
verses.20: It prevented the work of God from being completed. Everything was pure, but it was still harmful for humans to consume it.
verses.21: It’s good not to eat meat, not to drink wine, and not to be in situations where your brother is sick or weak.
verses.22: Have faith in what you believe in yourself, and have that faith before God. It is good to not judge oneself in what one evaluates.
verses.23: And if someone who is supposed to be distinguished from others eats something that isn’t allowed, he is condemned for not doing so out of faith. But anything that isn’t done out of faith is considered a sin.
